hero.text: You can advertise your class, course or institute here. Rs. 500 a week, your poster included, booked one week at a time. Paid advertisements are always labelled Sponsored and kept separate from our own offers.

blocks.title: Please read before contacting an advertiser
text: This page carries two kinds of listing. **Sponsored** listings are paid advertisements. **Special ad** listings are ones we have chosen to run without charge, and may be for a project of our own or for somebody we know - which is why they are labelled differently.
RCF English provides the space. It does not guarantee enrolment, examination results, or the quality of any service advertised here, whether paid for or not.
Check details directly with the advertiser before you pay anybody anything.

blocks.heading: Advertise Your Class or Course
intro: One price, and it includes your poster: **Rs. 500/= per week**. A booking runs for one week at a time - when the week is up, book another if you want to keep running.

Your advertisement is seen by the teachers, parents and students who use this site for English every day. Everything paid for is labelled **Sponsored**, so readers always know what they are looking at.

blocks.heading: Tuition & Course Promotions
intro: Every listing here is a paid advertisement and carries a **Sponsored** label. A listing marked **Featured** has paid for a more prominent position; it does not mean RCF English recommends it above the others.

blocks.heading: Special Ads
intro: Listings we have chosen to run without charge. Nobody has paid for a place here, which is why these are marked **Special ad** rather than Sponsored.
Everything in the directory above was paid for. The difference is deliberate, and it is the reason the two are kept in separate sections.
blocks.emptyText: There are no special listings running just now.

items.title: You send the details
text: Send your class information and your poster using the enquiry below.

items.title: We review it
text: We check that the advertisement is educational, clear and accurate.

items.title: The fee is paid
text: The advertising fee is paid in advance of publication.

items.title: It is published
text: Your listing appears for the period you have paid for.

items.title: It ends
text: At the end of the period the listing is removed or marked expired.

blocks.heading: Paying for your listing
intro: The advertising fee is paid before the listing is published. Open the panel below for the account details.

blocks.heading: Submit an Advertisement
blocks.subject: RCF English - advertising enquiry
intro: Fill this in and it will open WhatsApp with your details written out, ready for you to send. Nothing is stored on this website and nothing is published until we have agreed it with you.

fields.name: I confirm the information above is accurate
I agree that RCF English may publish the contact details I have given

blocks.title: Sending your poster
text: The form above cannot carry an image, because this website has no server to receive one. Send your poster as a picture in the same WhatsApp conversation once the message opens, or attach it to an email to us.
Posters are shown whole and are never cropped, so wording printed on your poster will not be cut off.

items.q: Information must be truthful and current
a: Qualifications, schedules, fees and contact details are the advertiser's responsibility, and they must be accurate on the day the advertisement runs.

RCF English may reject an advertisement that is misleading, of poor quality, or unsuitable for the people who use this site - which includes children, parents and teachers. We would rather run fewer advertisements than run bad ones.
Advertisements do not have to be about education. Anything lawful and decently presented will be considered. If you are unsure whether yours fits, ask before you pay.
The advertising fee is paid in advance. The fee pays for the listing to be displayed. It does not buy students, and it does not guarantee that anyone will enrol.

items.q: Listings end when the period ends
a: At the end of the paid period the advertisement is removed or marked expired. Renewing requires another payment and a confirmation from you.

items.q: We may remove an advertisement early
a: If a serious inaccuracy comes to light, or complaints are received, RCF English may take a listing down before its period ends.
A **paid** advertisement must not suggest that RCF English endorses, recommends or is associated with the advertiser. Paying for space buys the space and nothing else.

A **Special ad** is the other case. We take no money for those, and one may be a project of our own or something from family or a friend. They carry a different label for that reason, and the note at the top of this page says so plainly.
